kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نحترز (form VIII)
# نَحْتَرِزُ (naḥtarizu) /naħ.ta.ri.zu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَرَزَ (iḥtaraza)
# نَحْتَرِزَ (naḥtariza) /naħ.ta.ri.za/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَرَزَ (iḥtaraza)
# نَحْتَرِزْ (naḥtariz) /naħ.ta.riz/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِحْتَرَزَ (iḥtaraza)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
